2f43258.summary: Builds the localized ability description text for the card's active ability, choosing the load, effect or reload variant of the text term. It then expands modular description terms, card names, melee/ranged/reanimate and trait names, and Energy icon tags. Used when showing ability text on a card.
comments: Find the active ability card, and whether it is a loadable (siege-style) ability
Ability needs loading: pick the '-load' text before loading, or '-effect' text once loaded
No '-load' text defined: fall back to the generic siege text
Normal ability: build the term name from the ability's key (custom text key if set, else card id)
Not a loadable ability: use the plain text, or the reload variant if the unit has lost its reload trait
Reload text: strip the reload marker from the translated string
Empty text: nothing to substitute
Text has modular-term markers: expand each one from the Modular_Description terms
Marker holds comma-separated parts: part 0 is the term, parts 1 and 2 are parameters
Insert the first parameter into the term text
Insert the second parameter into the term text
Replace the whole marker in the description with the expanded term
Decompiler output below is dispose/finally cleanup for the enumerators and jumps back; calls are right
Next: if the text has card-name markers, replace each with the localized card name
Text has Energy markers: replace each numbered marker (0 to 8) with the Energy sprite tag
Wrap keywords melee, ranged and reanimate in bold no-break tags using their menu translations
Loop over every DefinedTrait and replace its marker with the display name of the trait
Card-name markers: look up each card id and swap in its localized name
Start from the Card_Name term, then prefer the name from the player's card collection when found
Card collection manager missing: just log it and keep the term text
End of function; decompiler dead-end null check, not real behaviour

2f43454.summary: Spawns a trigger animation prefab under the card UI's effects anchor and returns it. Passes the source card and target to the effect controller and sets the displayed trait value. Warns and returns null if no prefab is given.
comments: No prefab supplied: warn and bail out
Parent the new animation under the card's effects anchor
If the prefab has an effect controller, tell it this card and the target card
If it has a value display, show the trait value on it

2f2dc50.summary: Refreshes the card's health, attack, cost and trait icons, then for units checks whether the unit is dead. Handles destroyed drop pods, survivor activation, turning into a remnant, or marking the unit waitingToDie.
comments: Refresh all on-card texts and icons first
Only units can die; other card types stop here
Builds a debug log message (string concat of the CheckIfDead info); not game logic
Card with no starting health cannot die by health: ignore
Unit with the drop pod trait in an in-play state: a drop pod with no health is destroyed instead
Read current health; if still above zero the unit is alive, nothing more to do
Unit is not in an in-play state: warn and skip
Survivor charges left: use one instead of dying
Sacrifice units trigger their sacrifice effect when it is their owner's turn
No survivor left: a unit that must become a remnant triggers backlash and transforms (once)
Otherwise mark the unit as waiting to die
Hide the can-attack and ability animations, then run on-death backlash actions
Decompiler null-check landing; not real behaviour

2f4386c.summary: Sets the card's base melee attack to a new value, first removing its own (non-extrinsic) addStats effects that change melee attack. Updates the attack text. Used when an effect rewrites a unit's base attack.
comments: Walk the active effects backwards so removals do not shift unvisited entries
Only intrinsic effects (not from other cards' auras) are removed
Remove stat buffs that change melee attack
Store the new value in the anti-cheat wrapped base attack field
Refresh the attack number shown on the card

2f439c8.summary: Adds a (possibly negative) amount to the card's armour, never letting armour fall below zero, and refreshes the health text.
comments: Read current armour, add the amount and store it back
Armour went negative: clamp to zero
Armour is shown with health, so refresh the health text

2f43acc.summary: Sets a new base max health: removes this card's own health buffs, adds the extrinsic (aura) health bonuses on top, stores the result as max health and caps current health to it. Refreshes the health text.
comments: Walk effects backwards, summing health bonuses from extrinsic (other card) effects
Intrinsic stat buff that changes health: it is being replaced by the new base
If it also changes attack, only zero its health part; otherwise remove the whole effect
Extrinsic addStats effects keep applying: add their health change to the bonus
New max health is the new base plus extrinsic bonuses
Current health cannot exceed the new max health
Update the displayed health

2f43d64.summary: Forces both max health and current health of the card to the given value (healing to full) and refreshes the health text. Also remembers it as the card's newMaxHealth.
comments: Remember the forced value as the new max health
Set max health
Set current health to the same value, so the unit is at full health
Update the displayed health

2f43e18.summary: Sets the card's current health to zero. It does not check for death; callers use UpdateFigures or CheckIfDead afterwards.
comments: Write zero into the anti-cheat wrapped current health

2f3c664.summary: Applies a CardEffect (buff, trait, enchantment, mark and so on) to this card depending on its buff type, updating stats, traits, drop pod stats and the active effect list. Returns false if the effect is rejected, true otherwise, and rechecks trait combinations at the end.
comments: Card is in a state that cannot take effects (hand/dead style states): warn and reject
Effect comes from a card with the jam trait: its extrinsic effects are ignored
Extrinsic (aura) effect: first check for duplicates from the same source
Same aura already applied: non-variable ones are ignored; variable ones are replaced unless identical
Remnants only accept remnant traits and health buffs
Aura from a minion that has left play is rejected, unless it is this card still being summoned
Now apply the effect depending on its buff type
Double attack is converted into a plain stat buff equal to the current melee attack
Buff types above 0x2d: set-attack, set-cost, set-health and remnant trait
Set melee or ranged attack: remove earlier set-attack effects, then add this one
Set cost: replace any earlier set-cost effect and refresh the cost text
Set current health: may trigger the Ecstasy ability, then health is overwritten
Unknown buff type: log a warning
Buff types 0x24 to 0x2d: replace ability and drop pod stat buffs
Replace the unit's active ability with the one from the enchantment, and refresh the ability icon
Drop pod stat buff: add its health and attack changes to the drop pod's stats
Switch on the remaining low buff types
Stat buffs (addStats and similar): merge into an identical existing effect, else add as new
No effect merged: add the new effect to the list
Apply the health change: damage is capped by max health, a heal adds on top
Apply any armour change
Merge test: same source card, id, type and timing, so add the numbers into the existing effect
Add trait (also used for remnant traits)
Poison is cancelled by the resistant trait, with an animation
Survivor trait with zero health is ignored
Blind: lasts until the enemy turn start, forces melee attack
Count-stacking traits start at a trait value of 1
Look for an existing equal trait effect to stack with, by max, sum or count
Nothing stacked: add this as a new effect and give the trait silently
Drop pod: reset drop pod health and attack to the starting values
Gaining survivor clears the spent-survivor marker
Gaining resistant while poisoned removes the poison
Tide and companion: set their counters from the current values
Pin down forces ranged attack type
Markerlight and hunt mark: tell the battle manager the mark was resolved (sent to the other player)
If in play, show the trait activation animation
Remove trait: stealth loss is broadcast, earlier trait effects removed, trait removed
Swap stats: not allowed on a warlord (logs an error); otherwise rebuild base attack and health
Case 6 and 0x1e: clear earlier effects of this type and all extrinsic ones, then add
Mark of chaos: trigger the mark enchantment on this card and broadcast it resolved
Set health: replace earlier set-health effect, maybe trigger Ecstasy, then set current health
Remove all extrinsic effects that came from the enchanting card
Enchantment buff types: hand over to AddEnchantment
Enchantment with card: register it as active enchantment, then handle special enchantment ids
Enchantment id 0x78 is a quest: replace older quest buffs, mark as quest and show status
Enchantment id 0x3c is a secret
Enchantment id 0x82 is a mutation: spend it and trigger it at once
Enchantment ids 0xbe and 0x8c are marks: spend, trigger and broadcast as resolved
Mark of chaos applied via the battle manager's pending mark
Reflected copy: make the card ephemeral
Daemon host buff type is not implemented: logs an error
Refresh all figures and icons, then recheck trait combinations

2f44638.summary: Goes through all of the card's trait combinations and checks whether each one is now met.
comments: Loop over every trait combination defined for this card
Grants the combination's enchantment if all its traits are present

2f44768.summary: Checks whether the card has every trait of a trait combination. If so and the combination enchantment is not already active, adds it as an enchantment effect.
comments: Closure keeps the combination for the lookup predicate
Every required trait must be on the card, otherwise stop
All traits present: skip if the combination enchantment is already active
Build an enchantment effect for the combination, using a fresh enchantment id
Apply it through AddEnchantment

2f443f8.summary: Adds an enchantment effect to the card: records an ActiveEnchantment with a new id and stores the effect. If the card is in play, shows a status animation for every trait and updates canAct/canAttack for certain traits.
comments: An effect without an enchantment is only logged, and only when dev tools are on
Create the active enchantment list on first use
Record the enchantment card and a unique enchantment id from the battle manager
Add to the active enchantments list (inlined List.Add)
Also add the effect to the card's active effects
Card is in play: refresh status animations for every current trait
Two traits (ids 0x28 and 0x1cc) let the unit act this turn
Two other traits (ids 0x4f1 and 0x4fb) let it act but stop it attacking

2f44a78.summary: Returns true if the card's current trait list contains the given trait.
comments: Scan the current traits and compare each one to the wanted trait

2f442d8.summary: Returns whether two card effects count as the same trait effect: same trait, mark of chaos and daemon host, and equal duration flags. Used to decide if trait effects should stack.
comments: Trait, mark of chaos type and daemon host type must all match
Duration flags must match; turn-start flags only count if both effects are on the same player's side
Finally the until-next-attack flag must match too

2f41024.summary: Removes every extrinsic effect on this card that came from the given enchanting card, e.g. when an aura source leaves play.
comments: Walk the effect list backwards because effects get removed
Only extrinsic (aura) effects are considered
Source card is the given enchanting card: remove the effect

2f44bc0.summary: Returns the Marks of Chaos the card does not have yet, by looping over all MarkOfChaosType values and skipping owned ones. The rest of the output is merged code for the daemon host version; logs the count.
comments: Marks already on the card
Loop over every mark type in the enum
Skip marks the card already has, add the rest to the result
Enumerator cleanup, then log how many marks are available and return the list
Decompiler merged GetAvailableDaemonHosts and other methods in below; same logic for daemon hosts
Code from here on is unrelated merged code (counts mark of chaos effects); unreliable

2f4503c.summary: Returns the daemon host types the card does not have yet, by looping over all DaemonhostType values and skipping owned ones. Logs how many are available.
comments: Daemon hosts already on the card
Loop over every daemon host type in the enum
Skip owned hosts, add the rest to the result
Enumerator cleanup, then log the count and return the list
Code from here on is unrelated merged code (counts mark of chaos effects); unreliable
